name: gate-agents
summary: Six reviewer agents: planner (plan first), bug-gate (adversarial review of the exact diff), playtester (stranger on a phone), bottleneck (finds the real constraint), judge (final ruling), check-checker (do we need this check at all).

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (plans, gate verdicts and playtests are written under it)

needs: playtester only: a headless browser you supply
notes: The builder agent ships in the turn-cap-builder pattern. Agent files are copied to ~/.claude/agents only if the name is free.
